body.statement: For every fixed \(t_0>0\), \(\zeta>0\), and \(C\ge1\), there is \(c^\star<\infty\), independent of \(T\), \(|\mathcal X|\), and \(|\mathcal H|\), such that \(\sup_{M\in\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C)}E_M[(\widehat\theta_{k_T}-\theta(K,e))^2]\le c^\star T^{-\beta}\) for all sufficiently large \(T\). In particular, the overlapping-history covariance sum is geometric and introduces no logarithmic loss.
body.justification: This supplies the explicit observable-data attaining estimator and removes a possible spurious logarithm from overlapping windows.
body.gap: HuWager2023, Lemmas 2.3 and 2.4 and Theorem 2.1, give the PHIW bias and variance benchmark; the present statement makes the one-trajectory, cardinality-uniform bound explicit on the fixed latent-overlap subclass and sharpens the covariance summation without changing the exponent.
body.consumer: The bound gives a deployable history length for the refreshed finite insulin model without estimating latent stationary ratios.
